entry_profile.composition_invariant: No mandatory primary faculty or fixed support count.

environment_readiness.credential_boundary: Explain and request access only when needed; never embed credentials in a package.

purpose: Carry only the reusable Project Kernel relation into the autonomous and Form-preconfigured products while each product retains its own entry state, builder, bytes and proof.
transfer_rule: Transfer a result-changing neutral relation in owner-native form; never copy the originating system identity, private topology, temporal state, credentials, authority or one package into the other.

update_protocol.movement: After a reusable autonomous Kernel change, update this contract, synchronize both owner-native copies and their mechanical version locks, rebuild each lane and compare their generated family signatures.
update_protocol.source: This contract is the transferable family interface, not a semantic kernel or product state owner.
update_protocol.stop: A synchronized contract does not prove implementation. A lane remains divergent until its generated artifact satisfies the shared invariants and its lane-specific entry relation.
